study_role: untouched small confirmation of the v9 repair after the sealed v8 failure
question: Does the v9 scale-conditioned acquisition-support repair reduce silent-invalid tensor-coherence risk on different BioSR cells under the unchanged v8 challenge while preserving useful coverage?
measurement_rule: Use the unchanged v7 linear and v7.1 nonlinear estimators, physical scales, reference policies and invalidity tolerances. Only tensor-coherence validity scoring changes as declared below.
challenge_rule: Reuse all fourteen v8 degradation definitions exactly. Use a new stochastic base seed and different source cells; do not remove or alter any condition.

selection.selection_rule: Exclude every v7 and v8 F-actin cell, then rank remaining central-directory identifiers with the unchanged v7 SHA-256 selector. Pixel values and endpoint outcomes are forbidden inputs.

randomness.rule: For stochastic conditions, derive a NumPy seed from SHA-256(base_seed|base_pair_id|condition_id), using the first eight digest bytes modulo 2^32.

registration.rule: Audit registration once on each undegraded source pair and reuse that eligibility record for every coordinate-preserving degradation of that pair.
registration.rationale: Every frozen transformation preserves array extent and specimen coordinates; registration cannot act as a hidden degradation classifier.

v9_scale_conditioned_support.combination_rule: maximum of v7 acquisition QC, physical sampling, mild-perturbation stability, identifiability and v9 scale-conditioned acquisition support
v9_scale_conditioned_support.v7_strong_blur_resolution_margin_role: diagnostic only; it failed to detect stable degradation bias in v8 and is excluded from v9 coherence acceptance
v9_scale_conditioned_support.orientation_distribution_rule: unchanged v7 contract; v9 superiority is not claimed for this family

decision_rules.pass: The repair is confirmed for this BioSR stress challenge and may enter the tool profile with its exact scope. Publication-wide universal validity claims still require broader independent modalities and users.
decision_rules.fail: The v9 repair is not promoted. Preserve the failure, diagnose it on development evidence and use different cells for any later confirmation.
decision_rules.not_assessable: Do not describe superiority. The confirmation did not contain enough invalid comparator emissions.

access_boundary: Before this configuration and its lock are completed, no pixel array or endpoint outcome from the eight selected v9 cells may be decoded or computed. Central-directory names and MRC headers are permitted.
claim_boundary: Independent-cell confirmation of selective tensor-coherence support under a specified BioSR controlled-degradation challenge. Not biological ground truth, image-restoration accuracy, diagnosis, clinical validity, universal tissue validity or Nature-level external validation by itself.
